verdict.rationale: Postman's docs explicitly confirm scripting support for both pre-request and post-response phases using a built-in JavaScript runtime, enabling dynamic behavior, variable passing between requests, and response validation—directly matching the story's request-chaining and data-massaging use case. This is corroborated by long-standing community usage confirming collections/scripting workflows are core to the product. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on demonstration of complex chaining scenarios or edge-case scripting limitations.
